name: PhoenixRepo
track: 02 The Agent That Can Explain Why
summary: An agent team decides whether an abandoned repository should be revived. Every claim in the verdict cites a Zetaris row. H-MEM remembers those verdicts. Meterless Nightshift is the primary model provider.

zetaris.role: Load-bearing evidence source. The agents' only facts are rows from phoenix.repo_evidence and phoenix.revival_signals, fetched with the REST SQL contract.
zetaris.sample: data/sample/*.csv is a labelled synthetic cache of those view shapes. Sample mode still goes through the Zetaris adapter and also serves data/real when that snapshot is present. There is no GitHub fallback.
zetaris.real_snapshot: data/real is a committed GitHub REST snapshot collected 2026-10-22T15:14:30Z for golang/dep, jxnblk/rgx, discreteoptimization/setcover, jondot/hygen, and 42wim/matterbridge. hygen is RESURRECTION_FAILED because the CI setup step Use Node.js 14.x failed; a verification note records Cache service responded with 400 inside actions/setup-node@v2, and the jobs log download was HTTP 403. matterbridge is CANDIDATE with CI unknown: its build workflow runs are fork pull requests awaiting approval, a CodeQL success is not build CI, and there is no qualifying stage-1 success. Revival attempts for Fu93/hygen were collected 2026-10-22T15:53:26Z: compare ahead_by 0, Actions total_count 0, every stage not_attempted. A follow-up GitHub fetch at 2026-10-22T16:24:45Z added workflow steps, advisory rows for ejs and degit, and the test-helper excerpt. The deterministic PRD is docs/revival/jondot__hygen.prd.md. Stage 1 bumps checkout and setup-node to v4 and Node 20.x and keeps yarn hygen:build -- init self. Stage 2 cites the verified advisories. Stage 3 cites https://github.com/jondot/hygen/issues/450. scripts/zetaris/load_real.ps1 and the opt-in scripts/zetaris/phoenix-real-data.compose.yml mount /home/zetaris/customer-data/shared/phoenix_real on service driver. They were not executed against the user's Docker Zetaris.

meterless_engine.hmem: MemoryStoreService, MemoryRetrievalService, and TrustLedgerService. In-run evidence memories are recalled into the judge step. Verdicts are promoted to long-term memory and retrieved by type before the top-k cut, so later runs still cite the prior verdict after repeated evidence writes. Repeated evidence for the same claim is refreshed, not stacked.
meterless_engine.markovian: Chunk manager with a bounded carryover between agent steps. The default step budget is 24 chunks and 190 seconds. The Nightshift chat client times out one second before that budget.
meterless_engine.tests: tests/engines/test_hmem_conformance.py and tests/engines/test_markovian.py are project tests modelled on the published spec. The official TypeScript conformance suite was not run.

meterless_runtime.role: Primary, selectable LLM provider. OpenAI-compatible Nightshift contract from the Power prompt on meterless.ai/engines.html (fetched 22 Oct 2026).
meterless_runtime.served_model_observed: On 22 Oct 2026 15:00 BST, chat requesting meterless/auto and nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b both returned HTTP 200 with response model nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b. Traces record requested_model and served_model.
meterless_runtime.discovery: GET /v1/models. /healthz is not treated as proof.

nvidia.role: Secondary dev fallback only, selected with LLM_PROVIDER=nvidia. The intended Nemotron path is a Nightshift lane, with the NVIDIA key stored in Nightshift rather than in this app.
nvidia.note: The Nightshift Nemotron lane observed on 22 Oct 2026 is nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b, set with MODEL_NAME. Nightshift rerouted that request and meterless/auto to nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b. nemotron-3.5-super-vl-120b was reported flaky. NVIDIA_MODEL is only for the direct fallback.

sample_mode: SAMPLE_MODE=true runs the investigation logic on the labelled cache, and on data/real when present, with a deterministic stand-in for the LLM. It does not call the live LLM judge and it does not read output_examples/.
live_judge: Live mode asks Nightshift to accept or reject archaeologist and market-judge output. The judge is advisory. A reject can force one retry. When retries are exhausted, or the judge times out, returns 401, or errors, the deterministic policy verdict is still produced. The trace action LLM_JUDGE records the decision or the failure, and metadata.llm.judge copies it into the verdict. The judge does not end the run with 422, 502, or 401. A missing evidence id still overrides an LLM accept. Nightshift lanes are Nightshift-managed (NVIDIA, Google Gemini, OpenRouter including free models, and the local runtime) and may serve a different model than the one requested. Every LLM trace event stores requested_model and served_model inside the hash chain. HTTP 429, HTTP 502, and timeouts retry only while the step budget remains; a lane that fails is skipped for the rest of the run. 401 and 403 do not retry and do not move to the next lane. If the budget or the lanes are exhausted, the deterministic stand-in still returns a verdict. This path does not call the NVIDIA API directly. This call was not executed against Nightshift in CI.
